brief_title: Effect of Gemcabene on the Pharmacokinetics of Atorvastatin in Healthy Volunteers
official_title: A Study of the Effect of Oral, Multiple-Dose 300 mg and 900 mg Gemcabene (CI-1027) Administration on the Steady-State Pharmacokinetics of Atorvastatin 80 mg
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of gemcabene on the pharmacokinetics of atorvastatin 80 mg

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males and Females
* 18-65 years of age
* Good health as determined by medical history, physical examination, vital signs, ECG, and clinical laboratory measurements;
* Body weight 45 kg or greater, with a body mass index (BMI) ≤ 35 kg/m² (weight \[kg\]/height\[meters\]²)

Exclusion Criteria:

* If female, of childbearing potential or lactation
* History of significant adverse reaction to any lipid-lowering agent
